01 / THE NORTH STAR

PURPOSE BEFORE SCALE

An organisation.
A capacity to
keep becoming.

The cornerstone of Omnicorp is continual development of its ability to understand and act.

We imagine an organisation where people and AI work together, experience becomes knowledge, and knowledge becomes new capability. Where each useful thing built makes the next thing possible.

Products, revenue and physical operations give that development resources and contact with reality. Building is how the idea meets the world.

Explore the operating idea ↗
THE PRINCIPLE

Build useful things.
Become capable of more.

Opus 4.5: from conversation to working partner

Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.5 with reported improvements in software engineering, agents and computer use.

Omnicorp’s reading: a developer-work turning point, when delegating substantial work to AI became more compelling to us.

An attributed interpretation, not a measured community-wide adoption threshold. GitHub Copilot was already available in technical preview in June 2021 and generally in June 2022. Vendor testimonials are not independent productivity studies.
